meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以控制浏览器，帮你打开网页、填写表单、截图、提取数据、测试网站等，并且页面状态会保持，可以分步完成复杂任务。
howto.when: 当你要求“打开某个网址”、“点击某个元素”、“填写表单”、“截图”、“抓取数据”、“自动化操作”、“测试网站”、“登录”等浏览器交互时触发。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截图保存。
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器，打开该网址并截图。

say.text: 帮我抓取这个页面的所有文章标题。
say.note: Claude 会编写脚本提取页面数据。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱并检查未读邮件。
say.note: Claude 会使用扩展模式操作你已登录的浏览器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, test web apps, and automate workflows. Page state persists across script executions, allowing incremental task completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'go to [url]', 'click on', 'fill out the form', 'take a screenshot', 'scrape', 'automate', 'test the website', 'log into', or any browser interaction request.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will launch a browser, navigate to the URL, and capture a screenshot.

say_en.text: Scrape all article titles from this page.
say_en.note: Claude will write a script to extract the data.

say_en.text: Log into my email and check unread messages.
say_en.note: Claude will use extension mode to operate your authenticated browser.
